heading: Transportation alternatives portion of study
lead: In studying oil and gas alternative transportation systems, the Secretary shall consult with the Secretary of Transportation and shall consider—

tree.text: the extent to which environmentally and economically feasible alternative routes could be established;
the prospective oil and gas production potential of this area of Alaska for each alternative transportation route; and
the environmental and economic costs and other values associated with such alternative routes.
